text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...We narrowly missed first place, but it 
is a result we must accept.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I am well aware that no matter how 
perfectly one prepares, victory is never 
guaranteed.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"I thought sticking to this practice 
schedule would guarantee 1st place, 
but..."
choice_data_list: We're aiming even higher next time!
Let's aim even higher next time!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. In the sense that I gave it 
everything I had, I certainly did try my 
best.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Though her strength did not reach 1st 
place, one could certainly say 'she won 
the battle against herself.'"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you for your encouragement. Next 
time, I will definitely go for the win."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...! Of course. I have no intention of 
giving up here.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
These results are within the expected 
range, but while acceptable, they're not 
yet satisfying.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
A methodical plan is indispensable for 
achieving one's goals.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Once we're back, let's restructure our 
training schedule right away for the next 
race.
